description: RFC 7951 §4: a child is namespace-qualified only when its module differs from its parent data node. A list augmented into another module is vlan:vlans, and a key leaf defined with that list is name. A leaf a third module adds under the list is z:tag. Native JSON uses the same names, and a single-key list may be a dict keyed by the key value.

instances.name: rfc bare key and sibling, qualified third-module leaf
rfc qualifies a child of the augmenting module
